title: Performance raw dataset metadata
description: Metadata for one claim dataset under benchmark/datasets/<claim-id>/ (NFR-PERFORMANCE-007, AC-015). Excluded samples are retained with exclusion flags.

excluded.description: Exclusion flag: true when this sample was excluded from the claim aggregate but retained in the raw dataset.

exclusion_reason.description: Reason for exclusion (e.g. harness restart, thermal drift); empty when not excluded.
